diagnoses.description: Total selection over-trusted a corrupted TOTAL-like line (OCR digit flip 102.00→702.00) and/or used cross-variant voting without an internal-anchor override. The receipt contains multiple strong anchors (Subtotal/Payment/Total incl/Total Amt Rounded) that agree, so a single conflicting candidate should be rejected even if it matches a higher-priority keyword.
diagnoses.evidence: Allowed feedback: 074.jpg amount_correct=false; prediction total_amount="702.00". Source-run OCR debug shows conflicting candidates across variants: Variant 0/1 include “Subtotal : 102.00” and “Total incl. of GST 102.00” but also “Total ... 702.00” / “Total Amt Rounded ... 702.00”; Variant 2 yields only 102.00 totals. This is a classic OCR 1→7 digit flip where anchor-consistency must override keyword priority and variant-majority voting.

diagnoses.description: Rounding precedence failure: the payable total is the final TOTAL after a rounding adjustment, but selection can incorrectly choose the earlier inclusive total if it simply prefers the first/most prominent TOTAL-like line.
diagnoses.evidence: Allowed feedback: 077.jpg amount_correct=false; prediction total_amount="23.26". Image shows “Rounding Adj: -0.01” followed by bold “TOTAL: 23.25”, while an earlier line shows “Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26”. Source-run OCR debug confirms both values appear; the miss is precedence/selection, not OCR absence.

diagnoses.description: Two coupled failure modes: (1) schema/normalization bug emitted empty string instead of null; (2) total extraction is vulnerable to AMOUNT column-header lines triggering split-line fallback to item amounts and to OCR corruption of both keyword (GrandTota./GrandTotal.) and decimal separator (92:80).
diagnoses.evidence: Allowed feedback: 078.jpg amount_correct=false; prediction total_amount="" (empty string) violates task requirement (must be null on failure). Source-run OCR debug shows “Description Qty Price Amount” header, “a Total — 92:80”, “GrandTota. ... 92.80”, plus “Cash Received 100.00” and “Change 7.20”. Other variants show “: Grand Total” without a number, which can cause fallback to nearby payment lines unless tightly gated and excluded.

diagnoses.description: Date disambiguation failure: multiple plausible date-like strings exist and OCR can corrupt the DATE label (DATE→DATA), causing selection of a secondary date-like token rather than the primary header Date field.
diagnoses.evidence: Allowed feedback: 034.jpg date_correct=false; prediction date="2018-08-09". Visual inspection shows a clear header Date field (dd/mm/yyyy) and other header-adjacent date-like tokens; prior history and source-run notes include OCR-mutated label lines (e.g., “Data: ...”) that can be mistakenly prioritized by naive regex-first or weak ranking.

quality_impact.rationale: The current candidate image-ocr skill already encodes the necessary receipt-specific fixes implied by the historical failures (anchor-consistency override, rounding precedence hard rule, header-line exclusion + tight split-line fallback, tolerant GRAND TOTAL matching, decimal-separator normalization, and explicit empty-string→null guard). Additional edits would be largely redundant; the dominant remaining risk is downstream implementation adherence rather than missing skill guidance.

trigger_precision.rationale: Existing guidance is narrowly scoped to receipt OCR and triggers only under specific conditions (e.g., split-line fallback only when keyword line has no digits and is not a header; anchor override only when multiple anchors agree; optional upscaling only as fallback). No further broadening is needed.

instruction_compliance.rationale: Diagnoses rely only on permitted evidence (field-level correctness feedback, predictions, and provided images/OCR snippets). No oracle values are referenced. No tool execution is requested. No unnecessary skill files are modified.

solution_path_coverage.rationale: Covers all observed failure classes in the run: wrong date among multiple candidates (034), wrong total due to OCR digit flip/outlier (074), wrong total due to rounding precedence (077), and schema/normalization + header-triggered fallback issues (078).

skillaxe_evaluation.overall_rationale: The historical run’s misses are dominated by selection/normalization under OCR noise, not lack of OCR capability. The candidate image-ocr skill already contains minimal, transferable heuristics to address these failures; therefore, no SKILL.md changes are recommended in this iteration.

iteration_summary: Diagnosed the four incorrect fields (034 date; 074/077/078 totals) using allowed feedback and the provided images/OCR snippets. No skill file updates proposed because the current candidate image-ocr skill already addresses these failure modes; remaining risk is implementation adherence (applying anchor override, rounding precedence, header exclusion, and final schema guard).
